explanation: Bartolomeu Dias had rounded the Cape of Good Hope ten years earlier. At Malindi, in modern Kenya, da Gama took on a local pilot to guide him across the Indian Ocean.

claims.text: Vasco da Gama's fleet reached Calicut in India in 1498 after sailing around Africa, the first European voyage to do so.
Bartolomeu Dias rounded the Cape in 1488 but turned back before India, Cabral reached India in 1500, and Magellan did not lead the 1498 voyage.
Bartolomeu Dias rounded the Cape of Good Hope in 1488, ten years before da Gama reached India.
At Malindi, in modern Kenya, da Gama took on a local pilot who guided his fleet across the Indian Ocean to India.
